# ============================================================================
#  CAU HINH Guzz
#  Hau het tuy chon chinh duoc ngay trong app. Sua tay file nay thi chi can LUU LAI.
#  Dong bat dau bang dau # la ghi chu, app bo qua.
#  API key Google va token Hugging Face KHONG nam o day (xem README.md).
#  File config.txt cu (section tieng Viet nhu [KET_QUA]) van doc duoc; mo app la
#  tu doi sang dang nay, ban cu giu lai thanh config.txt.<ngay gio>.bak.
# ============================================================================


[OUTPUT]
# Thu muc luu ban chep loi. De TRONG = luu cung thu muc voi tep goc.
# Duong dan tuong doi (vd Transcripts) tinh tu thu muc chua tep goc.
output_dir =

# Ten ban chep loi. Cac bien dung duoc:
#   {name}      ten tep goc (khong co duoi)
#   {recorded}  luc tao tep goc, dang 2026-09-17_0811
#   {date}      ngay chuyen, dang 2026-09-17
#   {time}      gio chuyen, dang 1405
#   {model}     model Google da dung
filename_template = {name}

# Duoi tep ban chep loi: .txt | .md
extension = .txt

# Da co tep trung ten thi: number (them " (2)") | overwrite (ghi de) | skip (bo qua tep goc do)
on_conflict = number

# utf-8 | utf-8-sig (co BOM: Notepad cua Windows 10 truoc ban 1903 moi doc dung tieng Viet)
encoding = utf-8

# Kieu xuong dong: crlf (Windows) | lf
newline = crlf

# true = dau tep ghi ten tep goc, luc chuyen, model, thoi luong va thoi gian noi cua tung nguoi.
add_header = false

# true = chen dong "----- Đoạn 2/15 -----" giua cac doan, de doi chieu voi am thanh tung doan.
mark_chunks = false

# true = luu them ban do nguoi noi (<ten>.nguoi_noi.txt) canh ban chep loi.
save_speaker_map = false

# true = luu them am thanh da loc (<ten>.sach.flac) canh ban chep loi.
save_clean_audio = false

# Chuyen xong mot tep thi: none | file (mo ban chep loi) | folder (mo thu muc chua no)
open_when_done = none


[AUDIO]
# Cac duoi tep am thanh duoc nhan khi chon tep / keo tha.
extensions = .m4a,.flac,.mp3,.wav,.wma,.aac,.ogg,.opus

# true = loc dai tan giong nguoi (bandpass) va giam tieng on nen.
denoise = true

# Tan so lay mau khi xu ly (Hz). Google AI tu ha am thanh xuong 16 kHz.
sample_rate = 16000

# Am luong muc tieu sau khi khuech dai (dBFS). Cang gan 0 cang to.
target_dbfs = -16.0

# true = bo cac khoang lang dai: tai len it hon, chep loi nhanh hon.
# Moc thoi gian trong ban chep loi van tinh theo tep GOC.
trim_silence = true

# Khoang lang dai tu bao nhieu ms thi moi bo.
min_silence_len = 1000

# Nguong im lang = dBFS trung binh - so nay. Tang len = bo it hon.
silence_thresh_offset = 20

# Giu lai bao nhieu ms hai dau moi cau, cho khoi bi cut.
keep_silence = 400

# Do dai cua so (giay) dung de uoc luong tieng on nen.
noise_sample_sec = 1.5

# Bo loc bandpass giu lai dai tan giong nguoi, Hz.
bandpass_low = 80
bandpass_high = 7000

# Muc giam tieng on nen, tu 0 den 1. Cao qua de lam meo giong.
prop_decrease = 0.8

# Tu can bang do to theo thoi gian (giay), khi nguoi noi luc gan luc xa micro. 0 = tat.
level_window_sec = 3.0

# Giam tieng on dot ngot (tieng va dap, ho, keo ghe, ngay to): tieng nao to hon muc
# thong thuong xung quanh qua so dB nay thi bi ha xuong con dung muc do, ca truoc lan sau
# buoc loc on. Dai duoi 1 kHz duoc xu ly rieng truoc, nen tieng dap tram bi ha ma phu am
# cua giong noi van giu. 0 = tat. 15 = chi bat tieng that su to; 12 bat nhieu hon nhung de
# cham ca giong noi luc nhan manh. Khong tac dung voi tieng on chi to ngang giong noi.
transient_clamp_db = 0


[VIDEO]
# Tep video duoc xu ly giong het tep am thanh: app trich xuat luong am thanh roi chay
# tiep cac buoc trong [AUDIO] va [CHUNKING]. Keo tha video chung voi tep am thanh deu duoc.

# false = bo qua moi tep video khi chon / keo tha, chi nhan tep am thanh.
accept_video = true

# Cac duoi tep video duoc nhan.
extensions = .mp4,.mkv,.mov,.avi,.wmv,.webm,.m4v,.mpg,.mpeg,.ts,.flv,.3gp

# Luong am thanh se dung khi video co nhieu luong (micro cai ao, micro phong, tieng may
# quay). auto = luong dau tien; hoac so thu tu luong, dem tu 0.
audio_track = auto

# true = trich xuat luong am thanh ra mot tep trong thu muc tam roi moi xu ly. Nen bat:
# video nang hang GB, doc thang thi buoc nao cung phai giai ma lai ca luong hinh.
# false = doc thang tu video: do ton cho trong thu muc tam nhung cham hon.
extract_first = true

# Dinh dang tep am thanh trich xuat: flac | wav | mp3
extract_format = flac

# true = chep tep am thanh trich xuat ra canh ban chep loi (<ten>.am_thanh.<dinh dang>),
# nghe lai duoc ma khong can mo ca video.
save_extracted = false

# true = video khong co luong am thanh nao thi bo qua; false = bao loi.
skip_silent = true


[CHUNKING]
# Moi doan dai bao nhieu phut. Nhan dien nguoi noi bang model *-transcribe: toi da 30.
chunk_minutes = 10

# Tim cho LANG NHAT trong khoang +- N giay quanh moc cat, de khong cat ngang mot tu.
search_seconds = 20

# Doan cuoi ngan hon N giay thi gop luon vao doan truoc.
min_last_chunk_seconds = 60

# Dinh dang tep doan: flac | wav | mp3
format = flac


[GOOGLE_AI]
# Model chinh tren Google AI Studio. Model du phong: muc [FALLBACK].
#   gemini-3.5-transcribe : model chuyen chep loi, chi nhan am thanh (khong nhan prompt)
#   gemini-3.8-flash ...  : model da nang, doc cau lenh trong prompt_file
# Model quyet dinh cach nhan dien nguoi noi dung duoc (muc [SPEAKERS]):
#   *-transcribe  -> gemini (Google tu tach giong) hoac hybrid; KHOA pyannote + prompt
#   model da nang -> pyannote + prompt; KHOA gemini va hybrid (tach giong tren Google)
model = gemini-3.5-flash-lite

# Chi dung cho model *-transcribe:
#   smart    = bo tu dem (a, u...), tu lap, tu dat dau cau cho de doc
#   verbatim = giu nguyen tung tu da noi
# Model *-transcribe tu tach nguoi noi / tra moc tung tu thi bat buoc verbatim.
transcribe_mode = smart

# Ma ngon ngu BCP-47, cach nhau bang dau phay (vi du: vi-VN, en-US). De TRONG = tu nhan dien.
languages =

# Thuat ngu chuyen nganh hay gap, cach nhau bang dau phay. Model *-transcribe KHONG dung
# duoc tu vung khi tach nguoi noi / tra moc tung tu (Google tu choi), luc do bi bo qua.
vocabulary =

# Cau lenh cho model KHONG phai *-transcribe (khi tat nhan dien nguoi noi).
# Duong dan tuong doi tinh tu thu muc du lieu cua app.
prompt_file = prompt.txt

# false = yeu cau Google khong luu lai cuoc trao doi (store = false).
store_on_server = false

# Han muc token dau vao MOI PHUT cho model CHUA co dong rieng o muc [QUOTAS]
# (xem https://ai.dev/rate-limit). App tu gian nhip gui de khong bi loi 429. 0 = khong gioi han.
token_rate_limit = 10000

# Cho toi da bao nhieu giay cho MOT doan.
timeout_seconds = 600

# Loi tam thoi (mang, qua tai, 429 theo phut) thi thu lai mot doan toi da bay nhieu lan, moi lan
# cho lau hon. Het han muc TRONG NGAY thi khong thu lai: khoa model va chuyen sang model du phong.
chunk_retries = 4

# true = xoa tep tren Google ngay khi xong doan do (khong xoa thi Google tu xoa sau 48 gio).
delete_remote_file = true


[FALLBACK]
# true = model dang dung het han muc (429), qua tai (5xx, "high demand"), bi bo loc cua Google
# chan ("Input blocked") hay khong ton tai (404) thi tu gui doan do cho model du phong.
# false = chi dung model chinh; loi thi bao tep loi (han muc ngay van khoa model de hien o trang Han muc).
enabled = true

# Model du phong theo thu tu uu tien, cach nhau dau phay. App tu bo model trung voi model chinh va
# model khong hop voi cach nhan dien nguoi noi dang bat:
#   pyannote + prompt    -> chi model da nang (khong phai *-transcribe)
#   gemini / hybrid      -> chi model *-transcribe
#   tat nhan dien        -> model nao cung duoc (model da nang doc prompt_file)
# Uu tien model con nhieu han muc NGAY nhat: flash-lite 500 yeu cau/ngay, hai model flash chi 20/ngay.
# Thich chat luong hon thi doi thanh: gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite
models = gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-transcribe

# Loi qua tai / 429 theo phut: thu lai tren cung model bay nhieu lan roi moi doi model
# (chi khi con model du phong; khong thi thu du chunk_retries lan).
retries_before_switch = 2

# Model qua tai (HTTP 5xx) thi tam khoa bao nhieu phut, trong luc do dung model du phong. 0 = khong khoa.
overload_lock_minutes = 10

# true = model chinh het khoa thi doan sau quay lai model chinh.
# false = da doi sang model du phong thi dung model do den het tep (van phong dong deu hon).
return_to_main_model = true

# Doan sap gui phai cho han muc token/phut lau hon N giay ma co model du phong khong phai cho thi
# gui doan do cho model du phong luon. 0 = luon cho model chinh.
switch_wait_threshold_sec = 0

# Moi model dung duoc deu dang khoa: model mo lai trong vong N phut thi cho;
# lau hon (vd het han muc ngay) thi dung hang doi va bao loi.
max_all_locked_wait_min = 20

# true = dem so yeu cau trong ngay cua tung model, du yeu cau/ngay (muc [QUOTAS]) thi khoa model
# ngay, khong doi Google bao 429.
proactive_daily_lock = true


[QUOTAS]
# Han muc cua API key cho tung model (xem https://ai.dev/rate-limit). Moi dong:
#     <ten model> = <token dau vao/phut>, <yeu cau/phut>, <yeu cau/ngay>
# 0 = khong gioi han. Model khong co dong nao thi dung token_rate_limit (muc [GOOGLE_AI]) cho
# token/phut. Google bao 429 kem "limit: N" thi app tu ghi nho han muc do (xem trang Han muc).
# Han muc theo ngay Google tinh lai luc 0h gio My - Thai Binh Duong (14h hoac 15h gio Viet Nam).
# Doc tu https://ai.dev/rate-limit ngay 2026-09-18 (goi mien phi). Google KHONG gioi han token/ngay:
# han muc ngay la so YEU CAU/ngay (cot RPD), nen doan dai hay ngan cung tinh la mot yeu cau.
gemini-3.5-transcribe  = 10000, 3, 25
gemini-3.5-flash       = 250000, 5, 20
gemini-3.8-flash       = 250000, 5, 20
gemini-3.5-flash-lite  = 250000, 15, 500


[SPEAKERS]
# true = ban chep loi ghi ro ai noi doan nao.
enabled = false

# Cach nhan dien (phai hop voi model o muc [GOOGLE_AI], khong thi app bao loi):
#   pyannote : pyannote.audio chay tren may lap ban do nguoi noi cho ca buoi, roi gui
#              am thanh + ban do do cho model DA NANG chep loi kem ten nguoi noi.
#              Ten nguoi noi thong nhat tu dau den cuoi buoi. Can runtime pyannote (torch).
#   gemini   : model *-transcribe tu tach nguoi noi. Khong can torch, nhung nhan nguoi
#              noi chi dung trong tung doan (moi doan danh so lai), tu 3 nguoi tro len con
#              la thu nghiem, bat buoc verbatim va khong dung vocabulary.
#   hybrid   : model *-transcribe tra moc thoi gian TUNG TU, pyannote cho luot noi, app
#              ghep tren may (cach cua LecturerCleaner). Ten thong nhat ca buoi; bat buoc
#              verbatim va khong dung vocabulary.
method = pyannote

# --- pyannote (cach pyannote va hybrid) ---

# Python cua runtime nhan dien. auto = <thu muc app>\runtime\nguoi_noi\python.exe
python_path = auto

# Model pyannote tren Hugging Face (phai bam dong y dieu khoan tren trang model).
pyannote_model = pyannote/speaker-diarization-community-1

# Noi luu model tai ve (HF_HOME). auto = runtime\hf neu co san, khong thi <du lieu>\hf
model_dir = auto

# true = khong ket noi Hugging Face, chi dung model da tai (may khong co mang).
offline = false

# auto | cuda | cpu. CPU chay duoc nhung cham hon GPU nhieu lan.
device = auto

# Biet chinh xac so nguoi noi thi ghi vao (0 = de pyannote tu doan trong khoang duoi).
num_speakers = 0
min_speakers = 1
max_speakers = 6

# Nhan dien tren: clean (am thanh da loc) | original (tep goc, it bi meo giong hon)
run_on = clean

# Toi da bao nhieu phut cho moi tep (GPU: ~2.5 giay xu ly / phut am thanh).
timeout_minutes = 60

# Ghep luot noi (giong LecturerCleaner): pyannote hay tach giong nguoi noi chinh thanh 2
# "nguoi" (luc gan / xa micro), sinh ra cac manh ngan gan nham cho nguoi hoi.
#   Quy tac 1: luot ngan hon sandwich_max_sec kep giua cung mot nguoi, hai ben nghi
#              khong qua sandwich_gap_sec -> tra ve nguoi do.
#   Quy tac 2: luot cua nguoi phu ma trong +- density_window_sec nguoi phu noi tong cong
#              duoi density_min_sec -> tra ve nguoi noi chinh.
# Doi lai, mot cau hoi rat ngan dung le loi se bi gop vao nguoi noi chinh. Tat neu thay mat cau hoi.
smooth = true
sandwich_max_sec = 3.0
sandwich_gap_sec = 1.0
density_window_sec = 60
density_min_sec = 15

# Gop hai luot lien nhau cua cung mot nguoi cach nhau khong qua N giay (ban do gon hon).
merge_gap_sec = 1.0

# --- ten nguoi noi (moi cach) ---

# true = nguoi noi lau nhat goi la main_label, con lai "<other_label> 1, 2...".
# false = "<generic_label> 1, 2..." theo thu tu xuat hien.
label_main_speaker = true
main_label = Giảng viên
other_label = Người hỏi
generic_label = Người nói

# --- gui cho Google ---

# Cach pyannote gui ban do nguoi noi: file (tai len thanh tep .txt thu hai, canh tep am thanh)
# | text (chen thang vao cuoi prompt).
map_delivery = file

# Prompt cho cach pyannote. Bien {speakers} = ten cac nguoi noi trong doan.
prompt_file = prompt_diarization.txt

# true = moi doan van co moc thoi gian (tinh theo tep GOC).
timestamps = true

# Mau moi doan van. Bien: {time} {speaker} {text}. Tat moc thoi gian thi cap ngoac rong
# quanh {time} tu bien mat.
paragraph_template = [{time}] {speaker}: {text}

# Cach gemini / hybrid: gop cac tu lien nhau cua mot nguoi thanh doan van dai toi da
# N giay, ngat doan khi hai tu cach nhau hon paragraph_gap_sec.
max_paragraph_sec = 60
paragraph_gap_sec = 3.0

# Cach hybrid: danh dau [?] cac doan ma nguoi thu hai cung noi nhieu (nen nghe lai).
mark_review = true


[QUEUE]
# Mot tep bi loi thi: continue (lam tep sau) | stop (dung ca hang doi)
on_file_error = continue

# Xong ca hang doi thi nhay nut app tren thanh tac vu va hien thong bao.
notify_when_done = true

# Phat am bao khi xong ca hang doi.
sound_when_done = true

# Khong cho Windows ngu trong luc dang chuyen doi (man hinh van tat binh thuong).
keep_awake = true

# Hop thoai chon tep mo lai thu muc lan truoc.
remember_browse_folder = true

# Thu muc mo san khi chon tep. De TRONG = thu muc Downloads.
browse_folder =

# Keo tha ca thu muc thi lay ca tep trong thu muc con.
include_subfolders = false

[SYSTEM]
# Noi dat cac doan am thanh va ban chep loi tung doan trong luc lam. Tuong doi = trong thu muc du lieu.
temp_folder = tmp

# true = xong mot tep thi xoa thu muc tam cua no. Loi giua chung thi giu lai de lam tiep.
delete_temp_when_done = false

# auto = runtime\ffmpeg\ffmpeg.exe cua app, roi toi ffmpeg trong PATH.
ffmpeg_path = auto

# Noi ghi nhat ky, muc chi tiet (INFO | DEBUG), dung luong moi tep va so tep cu giu lai.
# Duong dan tuong doi tinh tu thu muc dung chung voi GoogleAITranscribe:
